Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal packet for Acme Robotics — highlights + next steps

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking time today — great to learn about the fleet optimization pilot and the latency/cost targets you outlined. Attached is a concise proposal and a cost breakdown that maps to the three traffic profiles we discussed (pilot, production-low, production-high).

Quick highlights: 
- Baseline latency SLO: 150ms (90th) with our recommended batching/kv-caching profile
- Estimated monthly token cost (pilot): ~$7k using a quantized 8-bit variant and prefix caching
- Dedicated pool option for production to guarantee throughput during peak windows

Attachments: Redwood_Proposal_Acme_20281122.pdf (proposal), cost_breakdown_acme_20281122.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If helpful, I can walk through the deck in 15 minutes — available slots: Thu 11/23 10:00-11:00 PST, Mon 11/27 09:00-12:00 PST. Or grab a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/avery-redwood/15min

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick alignment call (15m) to confirm scope and cost assumptions
2) Technical kickoff with your infra lead (if you want to proceed)
3) Pilot contract and reserved capacity options

Would love to hear which slot works or if you'd like me to loop in a solutions engineer for the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
